page.overview:
Who is Robert Freeman?

Robert Freeman (December 5, 1936 – November 6, 2019) was a photographer, best known for his work with the Beatles. From 1963–1966, he worked extensively with the group and did the photography and design on five of their album sleeves released consecutively on the Parlophone label in the UK, as well as on several albums on Capitol Records in the US and on various labels in other countries.

He was responsible for shooting some of the band's most recognisable images featured on several of their album covers. Freeman passed away on November 6th 2019 at the age of 82.
